overview_description.description:
About Pesto

We believe in taking opportunities to places where talent exists. Our mission is to change the lives of 5.2 million Indian software engineers. Creating access for them to great career opportunities using remote work. 

We train and upskill India's top talent for fast-paced product organizations. Our comprehensive training program helps software engineers in India to advance their programming and being remote ready. We unlock your potential and provide global opportunities, remotely. 

We started our journey in 2017 and since then we have helped more than 100+ candidates to find their first remote job opportunity. To get our candidates placed, we have partnered with more than 200 global product based organizations.

We are backed by Matrix Partners and a bunch of angels from Silicon Valley (list includes Ryan Hoover, Sahil Lavingia, Hiten Shah and many others).

Key highlights
•        Pesto creates overseas opportunities for Indian Developer.
•        Apply for India's simplest Remote development program
•        Become A remote Developer – Apply Now – ZERO upfront fee
•        High Paying Remote opportunity

Apply now - https://bit.ly/33BgZ30 

Hire software developers of Silicon Valley caliber: https://pesto.tech/become-a-developer

product.name: Pesto Fellowship Program
product.description: A 10-month live instructor-led training program for software developers with 1+ years experience, focusing on full-stack development and remote work readiness.

product.name: Live Lectures
product.description: Real-time online classes led by instructors covering advanced software development topics and practical skills.

product.name: One-on-One Coaching
product.description: Personalized weekly mentorship sessions focusing on technical and soft skills development for developers.

product.name: Side Projects
product.description: Guided development of real-world projects to validate skills and showcase capabilities to employers.

product.name: Job Support
product.description: Career coaching including resume building, interview preparation, and mock interviews to assist developers in securing remote jobs.

product.name: Developer Community and Networking
product.description: A virtual community platform for developers to collaborate, share knowledge, and participate in networking sessions with peers and mentors.
